Prototype 2 encodes N3 (100% pure) primarily through EEG (95%), with EOG (3%) and EMG (2%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated δ (+12.1 dB, sensitivity=18.7) and suppressed β_h (-0.2 dB, sensitivity=15.9).
The δ activity is present in 100% of each epoch (sustained), with moderate eye movements (SEM 86% active (likely EEG crosstalk)) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is partially coherent with N3 physiology: confirmed: δ elevated, δ dominant; missing: EMG atonic.
